title: INIU 45W 10000mAh Power Bank with Built-in Cable $17.33 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ INIU AU via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: INIU 45W 10000mAh Power Bank with Built-in Cable $17.33 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ INIU AU via Amazon AU

[Harsh Deep] i don't need this, i already got 3 different powerbanks. ( just telling myself)
[jssph] I really got to stop buying these things..
[EuphratesFate] Very good power bank for the price! Sadly I lost my cable, anyone got a link to buy spare cables that fits the lanyard on this?
[caprimulgus] Fyi, this one comes with built in cable.
But yes, I also would love to buy extra INIU short lanyard/eyelet cables, like the ones that come with their powerbanks. Someone please get them to sell them separately!
I have bought a short cable from AliExpress that has a keyring plug that the two end plug into…which works ok, but is friction fit, so nowhere near as secure as the INIU cables - I would hold a powerbank dangling from it (like you can with INII), because the lid would just pop off the cable!
[Krayzii] Another one before midnight
Glad of the change
[Fergy1987] Go go go go go!!! Buy buy buy!!!!!!!!!! Ok got it…phew
[parker2004au] Nope, give me a real percentage. None of this paw stuff
[Fergy1987] I never knew that's what the paw did haha …prob coz my last one is still in the box.
[Doowyah] Try add to cart and go to checkout to see the discount automatically applied.
Checked again but looks like deal is over.
[AP7] Is there a code? I see it as $33.99 in checkout
[kcajjack] damn it, I missed it. I was thinking of ordering one of these today as well!
[levqchi] missed again! one day i will grab one of these iniu powerbanks
[rednammoc] I got this from last deal. Very useful since it can charge anything I throw at it. It charges my steam deck from 0 to 65% and my Dell latitude from 0 to 40% while powerbank goes from 100% to 0.
[JumpingUnicorns] Me looking at my Iniu P55 with only 15W output sad that I missed this opportunity to add to my powerbank collection lol
[ohyesss] 2/3 INUI have failed for me and absolute pain to prove they have failed
[Thbloke] I use this as the power supply to a $60 car play screen, which I installed on my scooter. No phone holder any more.
[mathemagician] Email deal alert is basically useless for these, it's always over by the time I get the email.
[superroach] Honestly these are the GOAT chargers for their price. Fast charging, lightest practical size, with an cable that's replacable, while still having an USB A port to cover everything.
